# printer-agentui sweep

36 boards read. 29 changed, 7 unchanged, 3 questions (one of them covers 21 boards).
Every changed board with a menu was rendered (served locally with dc-runtime) before and after to check fit.

## 1. Changed

**agent-ui-03-runtime-states-connection-and-command-errors-matrix** (decision 1)
- "Starting the Agent panel." → "Starting the AI panel."
- "The Agent panel could not reach JusPrin" → "The AI panel could not reach JusPrin" (×2)
- "Handshake timed out while starting the Agent panel." → "Handshake timed out while starting the AI panel." (×2)

**agent-ui-04-chat-list-states-project-chats-matrix** (decision 1)
- "Configure Agent" → "Configure AI" (×3)
- "Set up the agent" → "Set up AI"
- "Connect an Agent to continue this conversation" → "Set up AI to continue this conversation"
- The "State=Agent unavailable" caption is a variant label, so I left it.

**agent-ui-05-message-states-conversation-content-matrix** (decision 1)
- "The Agent couldn't finish this response." → "AI couldn't finish this response."
- "If you'd like help with these, set up the Agent: it can explain them and fix what needs fixing." → "… set up AI: it can explain them …"
- Button "Set up the Agent" → "Set up AI"
- "Ask the Agent about your print" → "Ask AI about your print"
- "The Agent can describe the open project, …" → "AI can describe the open project, …"
- See Questions: the code no longer draws two of these states.

**file-printer-01-prepare-one-second** (decision 1)
- setup card `state="Agent working"` → `"AI working"` (the code's SetupCard.tsx says "AI working")
- composer `text="Agent is responding…"` → `"AI is responding…"`

**file-printer-03-prepare-printer-menu** (decision 1)
- The same two changes as file-printer-01.
- The printer menu gets a new row "Ask AI about printer settings…" under "Printer settings…", copied from the same Menu/Row markup. The order now matches Shell/PrinterMenu.cpp.

**file-printer-04-prepare-after-choice** (decision 1)
- The same setup card and composer changes as file-printer-01.
- Change row authors: "… @BBL A1M · Agent · 06:03" → "… · AI · 06:03"; "Agent · 3 steps merged · 06:04" → "AI · 3 steps merged · 06:04"; "Agent · 06:04" → "AI · 06:04"

**printer-02-canvas** (decision 1)
- Both printer menus get "Ask AI about printer settings…" under "Printer settings…". The panels size to their content.

**printer-03 … printer-15, printer-18 … printer-25** (21 boards; all have the "Print timeline panel" backdrop) (decision 1, no G-code hashes)
- "a71f 8c04 · no copies made" → "no copies made"
- "Layer shift reported near layer 62. Build 1 · a71f 8c04" → "Layer shift reported near layer 62. Build 1"
- This matches how the main-05/07/09 boards dropped "· a71f 8c04".

These boards also have menu changes (decision 1, settings rows):
- **printer-04**: "Filament settings..." → "Filament settings…" (the three dots become one ellipsis character), with a new row "Ask AI about filament settings…" under it. The popover height goes from 492 to 532.
- **printer-09**: "Ask AI about printer settings…" under "Printer settings…". The popover height goes from 202 to 240.
- **printer-10**: the same new row. The popover height goes from 216 to 242.
- **printer-11**: the same new row. The popover height goes from 286 to 312.
- **printer-18**: a new row "Ask AI about filament settings…" under "Filament settings… ›", with the same row style and no chevron. The panel height goes from 442 to 480.

## 2. Checked, nothing to change

agent-ui-02-recovery-states-historical-chat-matrix, agent-ui-06-first-message-after-open, agent-ui-07-printer-chat-states-behavior-completion-matrix, agent-ui-08-chat-scrolling-options, agent-ui-09-turn-activity-action-details, file-printer-02-prepare-fifteen-seconds, file-printer-05-chip-states, printer-01-showcase-canvas, printer-17-printer-chat-local-content.

On printer-17 and agent-ui-07, the words "Failed" and "Cancelled" describe printer connection attempts, not print outcomes, so I left them.

## 3. Questions for Kenneth

**The failed-print card in the printer boards' chat backdrop.** This is printer-03 … 15 and 18 … 25, 21 boards. Under the build card, the chat draws a dark card: "● PRINT FAILED · 13:09 → 14:13", then "Bambu X1C · stopped at 41%, 1h 04m in", then "Layer shift reported near layer 62. Build 1", with "Discuss this failure" and "Reprint" buttons. The 2026-11-06 decision says no outcome words: failed and cancelled prints read as nothing. In the code the chat's only print marker is "Plate 1 → printer", and nothing in the chat reports a failed print. The decision names Home printer cards and print history, not this old timeline design. Removing the card changes the layout of 21 boards, which is more than a wording fix. So I left it, apart from the hash. Should the card go, or be replaced, for example by the G-code marker line?

**Two agent-ui-05 states the code no longer has.** One is the file-notes card's "Agent unavailable" state, with its "Set up AI" button. The other is the "Ask AI about your print" empty-chat specimen. Commit bed54fd8fe1 (2026-10-21) removed both from the code, replacing them with the "Set up AI" bar under the thread. I updated their wording to say AI, but the board still draws them. Should they stay on the board?

**Printer and filament menus that are shorter than the code's.** The code's printer menu reads Printer settings…, Ask AI about printer settings…, Calibrate…, Add a printer…. printer-02, 09, 10 and 11 have no "Calibrate…" row. The code's filament menu reads Other filament…, Filament settings…, Ask AI about filament settings…, Calibrate this filament…. printer-04 has no "Calibrate this filament…" row and has an "Add a slot." row the code doesn't have. None of the decisions covers these rows, so I added only the Ask AI rows.

## 4. Needed elsewhere

- **comp-pinned-setup-card.dc.html**: the variant label table still says `"agentWorking": "Agent working"` and `"noAgent": "No agent configured"`. The code says "AI working" and "No AI configured." (with a selected preset, "No AI configured · using the selected preset."). The current variant's state already reads "AI working", so the compositions group may be partway through this.
- **file-printer-03's caption**: it still lists the stock rows as "Printer settings…, Calibrate…, Add a printer…". It should read "Printer settings…, Ask AI about printer settings…, Calibrate…, Add a printer…".
- These captions say "the agent's message" or "the agent switched": file-printer-02 (title and caption), file-printer-04 and agent-ui-06. They are notes for you and not misleading, but you could change them to "AI's message".
- agent-ui-04: commit 7bbc1f8154 changed the code's chat-list footer to "AI settings" with "Your account, keys, and the model new chats start with", and to "Sign in or add a key to chat with AI". You haven't decided on those, so the board follows a5c7620776 ("Configure AI" and "Set up AI to continue this conversation").

## 5. Overflow risk

- Each new menu row adds exactly one row plus one gap to its popover, measured by rendering. printer-04, 09, 10, 11 and 18 have fixed popover heights that were already 2–3 px short of their content before my change, and they stay 2–3 px short after it. Nothing is clipped visibly.
- printer-02: the canvas is 552 px and its content needs 553, the same before and after. The menu panels are not the tallest column.
- file-printer-03: the menu now ends at y≈789 inside the 800 px Prepare frame. It fits, but there is little room left.
- The new texts are shorter than or as short as the old ones in agent-ui-03, 04 and 05.
